motionContract.Idle: Natural low-amplitude breathing/ear or tail movement. Paws stay on identical ground pixels. Failed steps or body morph frames excluded, never code-drawn into fixes.
motionContract.Attack: Exactly one well-read wind-up/contact/recover action. 600-800ms total and first contact at 350-500ms. Frame and source-coordinate impact point recorded.
motionContract.Stun: Distinct exhausted lowered head/shoulder pose with weak motion. No death collapse.
motionContract.Hit: Static base + existing runtime white flash; no new hit sprite distortion.

qa: Inspect all raw frames, retain rejected sources and reasons, render selected timeline and actual-game-scale original-hero comparisons, validate source hashes, binary alpha, canvas margin, fixed Idle feet and contact metadata.
